description: With the client stopped (the connection file remains), `pardner client status` returns `INTERNAL_ERROR: fetch failed`. `client stop` reports the same state calmly as `{stopped:false, running:false}`.
expected: `{running:false}`, or `CLIENT_NOT_RUNNING` "Start Pardner with pardner open or pardner client serve".
suggested_fix: Treat ECONNREFUSED to the recorded URL as not-running in the status and operator request paths (shared with `client export`, F-141-02).

description: Reloading the board while the local service is down gives the browser's connection-refused page. The in-app Retry connection path and the recovery copy are lost, because the service is what serves the static shell.
expected: A service-worker-cached shell that shows "Pardner isn't running on this computer. Start it with `pardner open`." with Retry.
suggested_fix: Cache the static shell with a minimal service worker so the existing config-failure screen can render offline.

description: Clicking Retry connection while the service is still down changes nothing visible: no spinner, attempt time or 'still unreachable' state.
expected: A brief "Checking…" state, then "Still can't reach Pardner (checked just now)".
suggested_fix: Show a transient checking state and a last-attempt timestamp in the banner.

description: The PORT_IN_USE (foreign) advice "start with --http-port" works only on `pardner client serve`. `pardner open`, where the error was raised, does not accept --http-port.
expected: Name the command: "…or run `pardner client serve --http-port 7421` and then `pardner open`."
suggested_fix: Include the full command in the message.
